artifact: GLM app, creation session, and selected audit evidence

identity.verification_note: The attribution and registration are recorded claims. EXL3 quantization, hardware, and backend configuration were not independently verified.

training_violation.summary: The request says No training, but the recorded session includes execution of tools/train.py and the resulting export. This violation remains in the public session and analysis.
training_violation.release_action: No training was rerun during publication.

audit_chronology.earlier_report: audit/evidence/AUDIT.md predates access to the creation-session history; its historical BLOCKED statements about unobservable training/process evidence are retained verbatim apart from public sanitization.
audit_chronology.later_history_analysis: audit/evidence/PI_SESSION_ANALYSIS.md supplements the earlier report, records the history-backed training finding, elapsed time, usage, ordering, and failures, and does not silently rewrite the earlier verdict.
audit_chronology.later_compact_results: The selected numerical and browser reports are later audit evidence, not creation-session records, and were not rerun for publication.

omissions.policy: Screenshots, browser raw captures, large tensors, caches, node_modules, audit runners, and scratch artifacts are omitted with original hashes and reasons; no omitted bytes are published.

public_copy_adjustments: The shared sanitize_public.py helper recursively sanitized JSON keys and string values and sanitized markdown, code, logs, and JSONL text.

Private absolute paths, local/file URLs, internal addresses, sensitive values, opaque identifiers/signatures, and metadata cost fields were removed or normalized; per-file counts and hashes are in the manifests.
The full home-directory listings are represented by omission markers. The embedded PNG record is represented by an auditable omission marker.
README.md replaces its screenshot reference with an explanatory omission sentence. Screenshot files and all other image binaries are not published.
pixel_check.js retains only the safe data:image/png;base64, constructor literal because its bytes are generated at runtime; no encoded image bytes or screenshot asset is published.
package_metadata_note: package.json and package-lock.json are unchanged source metadata copies. package.json declares MIT/private and Playwright ^1.54.0; package-lock.json declares ISC at the root and Playwright/playwright-core 1.63.0 under Apache-2.0. This mismatch is disclosed, not corrected or relicensed.
source_integrity: Included source-file original SHA256 values and public-copy SHA256 values are recorded per file in the app, session, and audit sanitizer manifests. No original git history is included.
scope_limits: The app source and original tests/tools are included for inspection; training.py is evidence only and was not executed for this publication.
No source bug fix, retraining, or new audit was performed while assembling this subtree.
User attribution and logged model/provider names are intentionally distinct from independent model verification.
